description:
This image is a screenshot of the "Add Ingestion" user interface in a Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) application, specifically showing the "Dataset Selection Upload Dataset - Vector" step. The interface is organised in a vertical form layout.

The progress indicator at the top shows two steps:
1. "Input Type Selection" (greyed out, implying completion)
2. "'Dataset Selection Upload Dataset - Vector'" (highlighted in green, indicating the active step)

The form fields include:
- "Name*" (required input field)
- "Country*" (required input field)
- "Region" (with placeholder text "Select a country")

Below these fields, two tabs are present for data upload:
- "File Upload" (currently active, indicated by a green underline and icon)
- "URL Upload"

Within the "File Upload" section, a dashed-border box provides "Drag and Drop OR" functionality, with an "UPLOAD DATASET/S" button. Allowed file types are listed as ".tif, .TIF, .tiff, .TIFF, .zip, .h5, .gpkg".

At the bottom of the form, an "Attribute Name*" input field is present. Its description states: "Enter Attribute Name from Dataset (column from the attribute table) which shall be used as Input Parameter for the Class Code. Values of the selected attribute column must only contain upper- and lower-case letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens."

To the right of the "Attribute Name" field, two radio buttons allow selection of a resolution: "100 meters" and "10 meters", with "10 meters" currently selected.
